title: Dil ki zeenat
body:
dil ki zeenat dard e hussaini
sar ki zeenat paaye hussain
aankh ki zeenat khaalis aansu
lab ki zeenat haye hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
dars e hussaini allah allah
yun na samajh mein aa jaye
apne khuda ki jis azamat ko
sar de ke samjhaye hussain
dil ki zeenat...
<<DIVIDER>>
apne apne sinf o sin ke
kaise numainde nikle
karbobala ke tapte ban mein
chaant ke jinko laaye hussain
dil ki zeenat...
<<DIVIDER>>
shaam o kufa manzil manzil
sar tha naize par hamraah
zainab ka kya saath diya tha
zainab ke majaye hussain
dil ki zeenat...
<<DIVIDER>>
dil ke azadaron se poocho
gham ki lazzat gham par naaz
sab ko daawat har dam charcha
ghar mein hamare aaye hussain
dil ki zeenat...
<<DIVIDER>>
jitna kehna chaaha kehle
keh paate to kya hota
zehne aalam mein na sameina
jitna kehne paaye hussain
dil ki zeenat...
<<DIVIDER>>
mazhab o millat ke jhagde kya
markaz e haq to ek raha
jaise har insan ke dil mein
qadre shahadat jaye hussain
dil ki zeenat...
author: Aale Raza
